node.name: BobJoePickle
node.description: He was one of the good ones... Alas he is now just a pickle. Good for scaring a cat though!

quest:Obol_Altar1.name: Bad_Kitty,_get_off_that_altar!
quest:Obol_Altar1.description: Find something to scare the cat off the Obol Altar. Maybe from the Town Shop?

quest:Omar_Da_Ogar1.name: Helping_Omar
quest:Omar_Da_Ogar1.description: Bring Omar some thread to help him fix his Anchor Rope.

quest:Omar_Da_Ogar3.name: Helping_Omar_A_3rd_Time
quest:Omar_Da_Ogar3.description: Bring Omar some Sharks and a bobjoepickle so he can use them as bait to catch legendary fish on Saltwater Island!

quest:Omar_Da_Ogar4.name: Helping_Omar_Some_More
quest:Omar_Da_Ogar4.description: Bring Omar some Kraken and some bobjoepickles so he can use them as bait to catch more legendary fish on Saltwater Island!

quest:Omar_Da_Ogar5.name: Helping_Omar_Yet_Again_Deja_Vu
quest:Omar_Da_Ogar5.description: Bring Omar some new bait, I think he wants bugs...? Oh and some more bobjoepickles of course!

item:Grasslands2.name: Frog_Leg
item:Grasslands2.description: Imagine if humans had legs like this. Actually, it would be better if you didn't, unless you want nightmares about humans violently jumping at you from 20 feet away.

item:CraftMat1.name: Thread
item:CraftMat1.description: It's like string cheese, but without cheese. GET THESE FROM THE 'PRODUCE' TAB HERE IN THE ANVIL!

item:ExpBalloon3.name: Large_Experience_Balloon
item:ExpBalloon3.description: Hold down to gain EXP in the skill that's displayed in the corner of your screen. If you're in a town, you will gain EXP in the town skill. The amount of EXP you get is based on your skill's Lv.

item:Grasslands3.name: Bean_Slices
item:Grasslands3.description: There's something disturbing about how these beans have bones. Not as disturbing as how they also have eyeballs and walk around, but still disturbing anyway.

item:Fish6.name: Sand_Shark
item:Fish6.description: It's not actually made of sand, not even in this universe.

item:Jungle3.name: Carrot_Cube
item:Jungle3.description: Probably the only time you'll ever see a carrot cut into a cube!

item:Fish8.name: Kraken
item:Fish8.description: The tentacles writhe around as it plots it's next move toward bringing an end to this plane of existence.

item:Pearl1.name: Aqua_Pearl
item:Pearl1.description: Increases Fishing Spd by 30% 1% chance to be consumed every time you reel in a fish. Must be equipped in a Food Slot to give its bonus.

item:Pearl5.name: Holy_Pearl
item:Pearl5.description: Hold down to gain Class EXP. The amount you gain is based on your Class LV.

item:Jungle2.name: Snake_Skin
item:Jungle2.description: ''Theres a snake in me boots! Oh wait no, my boots are the snake!'' - Someone who wears snakeskin boots

item:Bug4.name: Fruitfly
item:Bug4.description: Hahaha I had my fingers crossed!

item:Bug7.name: Worker_Bee
item:Bug7.description: It's a bee and it's working. As per the Worker Bee Union Act of 1977, I am barred from making any pun or joke about them.
